name: mio-greeks-template
notes: Template, not a run config: no MIO Greeks run is approved yet. Added by the orchestrator; awaiting owner confirmation. ADR-0310 stage 2 Greeks diagnostics over ONE saved, closed MIO run directory. Replace the two PLACEHOLDER paths and nothing else changes the arithmetic. Diagnostics only: nothing here re-prices, sizes or reserves. Use from Python: MIOGreeksDiagnostics('greeks', params).run(None, {}) (the node reads run_dir itself and writes books.csv, cells.csv, exposure.csv and greeks-summary.json under out_dir). The window ends 2021-06-30 and sealed_from is 2021-07-01: the four selection quarters (2019Q4, 2020Q1, 2021Q1, 2021Q2) only, and the tool refuses any book dated on or after sealed_from or outside the window (RE-ENTRY: no 2022-2023 MIO economics before the 3 picks; no 2024+ data, A0003).

greeks.notes: run_dir is opened read-only (result.json, trades.csv, daily-account.csv and the pinned chain/bar files it names; never run.log); out_dir must be a NEW place outside run_dir. methods are the four WSL formulations. beta_min_pairs must equal the run's correlation_min_pairs (20 in the WSL jobs) and chain_cache_days only bounds memory. beta_lookback must equal each shock method's own shock.beta_lookback (60 in the WSL jobs); nominal_lp declares none, so this value is used and flagged in the summary. multiplier must equal the run's own solver multiplier (refused otherwise). rate 0.0 is stated in the output; the forward is the chain-implied parity forward (rate, dividend and borrow absorbed), falling back to spot with a forward_spot flag. dte_edges are half-open day buckets [lo, hi); the last edge bounds a monthly-only name's 3rd expiry. cell_by is the A0006 cell (ticker, expiry rank). min_total_usd nulls a cell's net share when |total P&L| is below it (the gross share is always given). The three hedge_* keys price the static delta-hedge column (hedge = -entry delta in shares, bought or sold at the fill close, unwound at the settlement close): hedge_fee_per_share is dollars per share per trade, hedge_half_spread_bps is per trade, hedge_borrow_rate is an annual rate paid only while the hedge is short stock (the book's delta long). They have no default (a default would be a hidden cost assumption); hedge_fee_per_share 0.005, hedge_half_spread_bps 5.0 and hedge_borrow_rate 0.005 are owner-accepted PLACEHOLDERS (2026-11-09: "Put that in for now but make note of it as a placeholder"); replace them with broker rates before any real use. Dividends come from the pinned bars' dividend_amount column when present; otherwise every row is flagged dividends_absent.
